content:
**Monongah Power Substation MZ-03** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

A small power substation extending power from the Monongah Power Plant to the local community around Lewisburg, it is located on Route 83A, next to Big Bend Tunnel West.

This substation, located just south of Big Bend Tunnel West, has its power box to the west, outside the fenced-in area. The shack has a number of containers and junk items that can be looted, though there is little else of note here.

Monongah Power Substation MZ-03 appears in *Fallout 76*.
